results.note: Connected with an app-owned npm start recipe (ARGUS_OUTPUT to .argus/raw.ndjson) and an argus:collector script over tools copied into .argus/tools: 20 windows and 8 incoming GET / spans, then a restart from the saved recipe with 19 windows and 5 spans; the raw capture had 26 samples. A ps check was sandbox-blocked; owned sessions were terminated.

GET /work p50 10 ms, p99/max 400 ms; event loop max 100 ms, GC 12 ms total, backpressure 18 ms total at /app/stream.js:12:3, flat memory. Ranked untraced waiting first and did not attribute the tail to CPU or a dependency; proposed a bounded reproduction with handler timing and a CPU profile.
Named the 100 vs 60 request mismatch and the 3000 ms declared vs 6000 ms recorded duration; compare returned comparable=false; declared no improvement.
Flat heapUsed/heapTotal while RSS rose 20 to 70 MiB, matched by external (2 to 52 MiB) and arrayBuffers (1 to 51 MiB). Called it external/ArrayBuffer pressure, not a proven leak; no snapshot taken.

eventLoop.max > 50,000,000 ns for 2 windows; the exact 50 ms window does not count. Fired at 3000-4000 (70 ms), resolved at 4000-5000; normal replay had no alerts. Activation recipe mentions sinks for delivery.
Empty recording: no measurements or root cause claimed; loss unknown; gave a capture recipe for spans and runtime samples.
Captured 500 ms of real dashboard SSE (6 history windows); kept loss unknown and reported backpressure call sites and external/arrayBuffers memory as unavailable from windows.

Rerun. Same measurements as Codex with units; noted the p99 is a single request among 6 and that samples cannot be matched to slow requests; hypotheses only, with a controlled capture as the next experiment.
Named the request-count and duration mismatches; all deltas zero; declared the comparison inconclusive, not an improvement or a null result.
Separated flat heap from external/arrayBuffers growth matching RSS; no post-GC baseline, so a leak is neither confirmed nor ruled out; proposed repeated cycles with GC between.
Strict > 50,000,000 ns for 2 windows; 50 ms equality window not a breach; fired at 3000-4000, resolved at 4000-5000; normal replay silent; activation with a file sink.
Empty file: insufficient evidence, no root cause, did not treat absence as health; gave a capture command.
Real dashboard SSE, 6 history events and 0 live; loss unknown; no hotspots or external memory in windows, so call sites and external memory are unavailable.
